name: Features
summary: Twelve features sections for the AhaSlides marketing sites (Webflow Features), in the layouts of the Untitled UI features sections the marketing team picked: alternating rows, an icon grid, an icon list with a photo, icon cards, icons around a phone screenshot, tabs with screenshots, a sticky stack of step cards, and four Compact layouts that show the same features in about 560 to 800 px at 1440 instead of 1000 to 2000. Framework-free HTML and CSS, bound to the shared --aha-* tokens and built from values the Hero, Cards, Hero banner, FAQ and Footer banner sections already ship. Every picture is a neutral image slot to swap for a real image. Each section has two backgrounds, White (the default) and Accent (add the class aha-features--accent).
highlights: Twelve layouts on one page, each with its own labelled preview and paste-and-run snippet

Four Compact layouts (tabs over one screenshot, swipeable card scroller, swipeable card scroller with images, top three with See all features) that keep a Features section within one screen; 48 px section padding, no intro sentence under the title, closed content stays in the HTML

Two backgrounds: White (the default) and Accent, the pale pink bgAccent surface laid over white by adding aha-features--accent to the section; the icon squares turn white on Accent so they stay visible, and the Feature cards stay white with their pink icon tile

Layout copied from Untitled UI; every colour, size, space, radius and font is an --aha-* token, and the title and lead carry the Hero section's values verbatim, and the buttons are <aha-button size="xl">

Every picture is an image slot (4:3 or portrait 3:4, the Cards and Hero banner ratios) with a neutral placeholder to swap for a real image; no third-party photo or device image, and no product recreated in HTML
Icon squares are the DS Feature card icon; the card title is the Feature card link
Icon cards reuse the DS Feature card from the Cards page unchanged; this page adds only the grid around it
Icons are registry glyphs called by name with <aha-icon>
Tabs with screenshots ships working WAI-ARIA tabs (arrow keys, Home, End) in a short framework-free script; the structure maps onto Webflow's native Tabs element
Each section is a container-query block: it steps down at 991 px and 767 px and tightens again below 480 px, wherever it sits

A landscape image, alone or among others of the same size, fills its slot edge to edge at their own ratio (aha-features__photo--fill): no frame, no inset, no crop. A portrait or square image (as tall as wide or taller) is always framed, even alone or when every image is the same size, and so is any section with more than one image whose sizes or ratios differ: they sit uncropped in a Vivid Pink frame (aha-features__photo--pink-frame): the centre Splash from the Background library behind the picture, an even inset, one 4:3 frame ratio per section. Photos exported at the slot's ratio keep object-fit cover

Sticky stack is pure CSS position: sticky, with no script: four white step cards stick near the top of the screen and slide over each other as the page scrolls, leaving a 16 px edge of the card beneath showing; the page scrolls at its normal speed and nothing animates, so reduced motion changes nothing

Alternating with screenshots has an Image switch, Fill or Pink frame, so one layout covers same-size screenshots and mixed or portrait ones; the old Alternating with mixed-size screenshots link lands on it with Pink frame to pick

layouts.name: Alternating with screenshots
layouts.summary: A centred header, then three rows that swap sides: icon, title, text and two buttons beside a screenshot. The Image switch picks how the screenshots sit. Fill (the default): every screenshot is landscape and the same size, so each fills its slot edge to edge at its own ratio (aha-features__photo--fill), with no frame and no crop. Pink frame: use it when any screenshot is portrait or square, or when the section holds more than one image and they differ in size; every screenshot sits whole in one 4:3 Vivid Pink frame with the centre Splash behind it (aha-features__photo--pink-frame), never cropped. Swap the placeholder for a real product screenshot. With a single row the section button is that row's own button in its text column, and the centred button row under the section is dropped.

guidance.title: Choosing a background
guidance.intro: Every layout below has a White / Accent switch in its preview and a tab for each in its code.

points.title: White is the default
points.text: Use White unless the section needs to stand apart from the white sections around it. It is today's look and needs no extra class.

points.title: Accent
points.text: Add aha-features--accent to the section. It lays the pale pink Accent background (bgAccent) over white, so it looks the same wherever it sits. The icon squares switch to white and keep their pink glyph; cards stay white with their pink icon tile, and image placeholders stay grey.

points.title: Neighbours
points.text: Never place an Accent section next to another coloured section. Put it between white sections.

points.title: Tabs are for parallel choices, never a sequence
points.text: Use the Tabs layouts when the visitor picks one of several equal alternatives (formats, slide types, use cases). A numbered how-to, a how it works or any set of steps is a sequence, so it is Step cards, never tabs: three steps are the Steps row (Cards aha-marketing-cards__grid--row), four or more are a Cards grid of Step cards that follows the balanced-grid rule (5 is 3 plus 2, centred). When the steps have screenshots, the Compact: swipeable card scroller with images (Step cards in an ordered list, each with its picture at the foot) is an equal choice to the Step grid. Moving steps out of Tabs keeps every step and its screenshot: five tabs become five Step cards with their images, never fewer. Keep every tab description to one short sentence of 90 characters or fewer, because a long description turns the tab list into a wall of text; screen-lint --surface=website fails `tabs-description-long` and `steps-as-tabs`.

points.title: Fill the slot, or frame mixed sizes
points.text: Never crop a screenshot. Size and ratio are those of the visible UI, not the file: a screenshot padded onto a plain canvas counts at its own size, so export each one tight to its UI. When the section holds one landscape image, or several of the same size, add aha-features__photo--fill to the photo slot: the image fills the slot edge to edge at its own ratio, with no frame and no inset. When an image is portrait or square (as tall as wide or taller), or the section holds more than one image and the images differ in size or ratio, add aha-features__photo--pink-frame to the photo slot, put the Splash icon in an aha-features__splash element behind it and give the picture the class aha-features__shot: each image is contained with an even inset on Vivid Pink (--aha-vivid-pink-100) with the centre Splash, and the frame keeps one ratio (4:3) for every row of the section. On Alternating with screenshots the Image switch sets this for the whole section: Fill or Pink frame.
